direction: Cinematic photographic illustration; landscape 1536x1024; navy background; violet rim light and cyan highlights; centered subject safe for wide card crop; realistic electric guitar; no text, logo, watermark, border or collage.

images.subject: An electric guitar resting on a dark practice desk beside a guitar pick, a compact metronome and an open blank practice notebook. Still life, no hands.
Close-up of a guitarist playing an electric guitar, left hand with four anatomically correct fingers poised across neighboring frets and right hand picking visible in background, coordination.

Macro close-up of a right hand holding a small guitar pick correctly between thumb and index, attacking one electric guitar string above the pickup. Two subtle short light trails suggest down and up strokes.

Perspective along an electric guitar fretboard, six straight strings and polished frets, small violet and cyan light points arranged in a tasteful ascending scale pattern over several frets. No hands.
Close-up of a right hand holding a guitar pick above adjacent electric guitar strings. A short continuous cyan light arc flows across three neighboring strings to suggest efficient picking.
Macro close-up of a guitarist left hand performing a string bend on an electric guitar upper fretboard, ring finger pushes a string sideways with supporting fingers, subtle violet wave of light.

Close-up of left hand playing electric guitar fretboard with index finger pressing one fret and ring finger poised for hammer-on on same string, subtle flowing violet light trail connecting the two fret positions.

Close-up of a right hand holding a guitar pick sweeping across electric guitar strings, a single diagonal cyan light ribbon crosses the strings, fretboard and arpeggio finger shape softly visible behind.

Close-up of two hands on electric guitar fretboard, right hand index finger taps an upper fret while left hand frets lower notes. Natural anatomically correct hands, unmistakable two-hand tapping technique.

Cinematic close-up of guitarist torso and both hands performing an expressive electric guitar solo, dark unbranded electric guitar, elegant violet and cyan flowing light phrase follows the neck. No face.
